meta.title: 통통 악기 놀이
meta.reviewed: Written by hand from source/BRIEF.md (통통 악기 놀이, a music-play app where dropped balls play the bars they hit (fictional app)). Every decision below follows the brief and the style it names; nothing is a preset.

source.notes: 통통 악기 놀이, a music-play app where dropped balls play the bars they hit (fictional app)
Korean OFL fonts, cut to the characters the reel shows

rationale.palette: A toy on mint: a pale mint ground #E6F4EE with a dot grid, eight rainbow mallet bars (red to violet), glossy marbles in pink, blue and yellow, ink #264653 for type; metal bars go silver for the vibraphone and the glockenspiel.
rationale.type: Jua, round and friendly, for the name and the lines.
rationale.motion: Every motion is a note: marbles fall and bounce from bar to bar on parabolas solved backwards so each one lands exactly on its beat; a hit lights the bar, dips it with a ring and sends a note mark up; two marbles half a beat apart make eighth notes; three landing together make a chord.
rationale.sound: The melody is the picture: every hit is a note cue on a recorded marimba, vibraphone or glockenspiel (VCSL, CC0) in C major, written first; under it a soft ambient bed at 128 BPM (pad, sub, a soft kick and shaker).
rationale.visuals: All code: the scenes read their hits from the same cue list the arranger renders (note:<instrument> deg= bar= ball=), and solve each flight as a parabola under fixed gravity between two hit times; bars are rounded keys with a highlight and pins.
rationale.narration: Not recommended: the marbles play the tune.
